desc.zh: 新闻里的“7 级”量的是断层滑了多大一块、滑了多远；你家晃得多厉害要看距离、深度和地基；地震可以算概率，却报不出日子。八个可以拖动的模型：弹簧木块、矩震级、烈度衰减、预警秒数、木块网格、古登堡—里克特定律、余震概率和一场预测游戏。
desc.en: The “7” in the news measures how much fault slipped and how far; how hard your home shakes depends on distance, depth and ground; earthquakes have probabilities but no dates. Eight models you can push: a spring and block, moment magnitude, intensity fall-off, warning seconds, a sheet of blocks, the Gutenberg–Richter law, aftershock odds and a prediction game.

desc.zh: 断层被摩擦咬住，几十年攒下弹性变形，再在几秒里一下子滑过去；间隔 = 每次滑多远 ÷ 板块速度。
desc.en: Friction locks a fault while strain builds for decades, then it slips in seconds; the interval is slip divided by plate speed.

zh: 断层为什么会突然滑动

desc.zh: 地震矩 = 岩石刚度 × 滑动面积 × 平均滑动量；Mw = ⅔(log₁₀M₀ − 9.1)。震级每加 1，能量约乘 32；加 2，约 1000 倍。
desc.en: Seismic moment = rigidity × slipped area × average slip; Mw = ⅔(log₁₀M₀ − 9.1). Each unit is about 32 times the energy; two units about 1000 times.

zh: 震级差一级能量差多少
地震能量相当于几颗原子弹
en: how much stronger is one magnitude

desc.zh: 震级只有一个，烈度每处不同：离得近、震源浅、地基软都会晃得更厉害。
desc.en: One magnitude, many intensities: closer, shallower and softer ground all mean stronger shaking.

zh: 为什么浅源地震更危险
en: how strong will the shaking be

title.en: S−P location and earthquake early warning

desc.zh: S 波比 P 波每晚到 1 秒，距离约多 8 千米；三个台站定出震中。预警抢的是 S 波到达前的几秒，震中附近是盲区。
desc.en: Each second of S−P lag is about 8 km; three stations fix the epicentre. Early warning wins the seconds before the S wave, except in a blind zone near the epicentre.

desc.zh: 一整片互相牵连的木块匀速加载，规则里没有随机数，却冒出大大小小的地震。
desc.en: A sheet of coupled blocks under uniform loading, with no randomness in the rules, produces quakes of every size.

en: why earthquakes come in all sizes

desc.zh: log₁₀N = a − bM，b 约为 1：震级每大 1 级，次数约少到十分之一。
desc.en: log₁₀N = a − bM with b near 1: each unit up, about a tenth as many quakes.

zh: 全球每年几次 7 级地震

desc.zh: 余震率约按 1/(t + c)^p 下降；一段时间内至少来一次的概率是 1 − e^(−N)。
desc.en: Aftershock rate falls as 1/(t + c)^p; the chance of at least one in a window is 1 − e^(−N).

en: will there be a bigger aftershock

desc.zh: 长期发生率是稳的，具体日子猜不中：在木块网格上，按“上一次 + 平均间隔”放窗口并不比随手放更准。
desc.en: Long-run rates are stable but dates are not: on the block sheet, a window at “last event + mean interval” does no better than one placed at random.
